items.title: Foresight AI Brings Gremlin Agents to Reliability Engineering
items.blurb: Reliability management company Gremlin has announced the general availability of Foresight AI, an agentic product that analyses services for potential failures, recommends changes and reruns tests to check that a fix works. By Matt Saunders

items.title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now supports custom Tooling blueprints
items.blurb: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now supports custom Tooling blueprints, giving domain administrators the ability to define the foundation of every project by using their own AWS CloudFormation templates.

items.title: TwelveLabs Pegasus 1.5 model now available on Amazon Bedrock
items.blurb: Amazon Bedrock now supports TwelveLabs Pegasus 1.5, a video-to-text model that generates structured, time-coded metadata from video.

items.title: AWS Network Firewall adds wildcard support for container attribute filters
items.blurb: AWS Network Firewall now supports wildcard matching in container attribute-based inspection filters for Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) and Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS).

items.title: Amazon GameLift Servers adds CPU burstability for container fleets
items.blurb: Amazon GameLift Servers now supports CPU burstability for container fleets, giving game developers greater flexibility in how compute resources are allocated and consumed at runtime.

items.title: Amazon GuardDuty RDS Protection now detects data exfiltration and destruction in Aurora and RDS databases
items.blurb: Amazon GuardDuty announces an expansion of RDS Protection that extends threat detection beyond login anomalies to identify data exfiltration and data destruction attacks targeting Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL…
